rows.b: A transistor whose gate remembers its electric polarization, storing a bit without power and switching at low voltage. It could make memory as fast as logic.
A chip whose logic can be rewired after manufacturing, so it becomes any digital circuit the designer describes. It sits between software and custom chips.
A regular processor shares its board with a rewirable logic chip that becomes custom hardware for the hot loop. Software speed where it counts, hardware speed where it matters.
